15 MLB teams play spring training in Arizona’s Cactus League, at 10 ballparks across the Phoenix metro area. Here’s where each team plays its home games. (cactusleague.com)
| City | Ballpark | Teams |
|---|---|---|
| Glendale | Camelback Ranch | Chicago White Sox, Los Angeles Dodgers |
| Goodyear | Goodyear Ballpark | Cincinnati Reds, Cleveland Guardians |
| Mesa | Hohokam Stadium | Athletics |
| Mesa | Sloan Park | Chicago Cubs |
| Peoria | Peoria Sports Complex | San Diego Padres, Seattle Mariners |
| Phoenix | American Family Fields of Phoenix | Milwaukee Brewers |
| Scottsdale | Salt River Fields at Talking Stick | Arizona Diamondbacks, Colorado Rockies |
| Scottsdale | Scottsdale Stadium | San Francisco Giants |
| Surprise | Surprise Stadium | Kansas City Royals, Texas Rangers |
| Tempe | Tempe Diablo Stadium | Los Angeles Angels |
